title: Simulation and Modeling Engineer
description: **Johnson Controls** **Simulation and Modeling Engineer** *European Air-Cooled Chiller Engineering | Dublin, Ireland* **What You Will Do** Johnson Controls has an exciting Product Engineer II opportunity based at our Dublin, Ireland location, supporting our new European air-cooled chiller engineering organization. If you enjoy applied thermodynamics and heat transfer, working with laboratory test data, and building the analysis tools that help an engineering team make better decisions, this could be the right position for you. In this role you will support the performance rating and thermal analysis of air-cooled chillers engineered for the European market, working under general supervision. You will run our chiller rating and selection programs, prepare and check the performance data behind EN 14511, EN 14825, and Ecodesign / ErP compliance, compare rated performance against results from test labs, and build your own analysis tools where the production programs do not reach. This is a product engineering role, not a software development role. Our core simulation models and production rating engines are developed and maintained by the global Modeling & Simulation team. You will be a skilled user of those tools – validating them against real test data, extending them with your own analysis, and feeding back what Europe needs – while continuing to build your expertise. **How You Will Do It** * Develops and applies an understanding of the theories, concepts, technical principles, and processes related to the fluid, thermal, refrigeration, and other mechanical aspects of air-cooled chillers, and of how they determine rated performance * Works under general supervision, following work instructions and defined processes to produce, check, and document chiller performance ratings * Runs and interprets chiller rating and selection programs for European products: prepares rating cases, checks outputs for consistency, and investigates anomalies with more experienced engineers * Prepares performance data for European products at full and part load in line with EN 14511 and EN 14825 (SEER, SEPR, ηs,c), and supports the data packages submitted for Ecodesign / ErP compliance and Eurovent certification * Compares rated and modelled performance against laboratory test data – reducing and plotting results, quantifying deviation, and reporting findings to the product team * Builds and maintains practical analysis and rating tools, mainly spreadsheet based, for parametric studies, curve fitting of compressor and heat exchanger data, and the cases production programs do not cover * Performs thermal analysis in support of assigned design work: heat exchanger sizing and selection, approach temperature and pressure drop trade-offs, refrigerant circuiting, fouling allowances, and high-ambient corrections * Supports studies of control and staging strategies – compressor staging and unloading, fan speed control, and low-ambient operation – and their effect on rated and seasonal efficiency * Supports refrigerant transition work, for example R-454B, R-1234ze(E), and R-290, by producing comparative capacity and efficiency data across the European range * Helps execute test programs at various laboratories: prepares test matrices, checks instrumentation and data quality, and processes the results used for rating * Responsible for engineering deliverables including rating notes, correlation reports, performance data sheets, and the assumption records behind published data; prepares, checks, and coordinates their release * Provides rating and performance support to application engineers, sales, product marketing, and product technical service across Europe, and can mentor new hires at the Engineer I level * Works with the global Modeling & Simulation team as a user of their models and rating engines, feeding back correlation results, data gaps, and requests for new capability * Works with engineering counterparts in York (PA), Wuxi, and Izmir to keep European ratings practice consistent with global methods * Reports the status of own work to the project team, with good written and verbal communication, and contributes to the accurate and on-time completion of projects * Continuously increases expertise across chiller design, theory, construction, operation, and applications; participates in process improvement * Adheres to the Company's Code of Conduct and Business Ethics standards **Required** **What we look for** * BS in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline / science * Minimum 2 years of work experience in a related field * Working knowledge of fluid and thermal principles, including analysis of the vapour compression cycle * Strong spreadsheet skills, with the ability to build own analysis tools for data reduction, curve fitting, and parametric study * Comfortable working with laboratory test data – reducing, plotting, and sanity-checking measured results * Able to organize and process large amounts of data * Working knowledge of European performance rating and efficiency requirements for chillers (EN 14511, EN 14825, Ecodesign / ErP), with awareness of CE marking, PED, and EN 378 * Good written and verbal communication skills * Ability to work in a fast-paced, schedule-driven, team-oriented environment * Ability to travel up to 10%, primarily within Europe **Preferred** * Experience using chiller or heat pump rating and selection software, whether JCI programs or equivalent OEM selection tools * Scripting for automation of rating runs and post-processing of test data (Python preferred), as a capable tool user rather than a software developer * Familiarity with compressor performance maps and heat exchanger performance – microchannel and round-tube-plate-fin coils, brazed plate and shell-and-tube evaporators * Familiarity with refrigerant property tools such as REFPROP, CoolProp, or EES * Familiarity with refrigeration systems and the EU F-Gas Regulation, including low-GWP refrigerant transitions * Exposure to Eurovent Certita Certification (Liquid Chilling Packages) or AHRI certification programs * Experience engineering industrial products in engineer-to-order, applied, or made-to-order environments * Experience with measurement uncertainty analysis in a test laboratory environment * Experience with thermal analysis tools such as EES, or computational fluid dynamics (CFD) analysis tools or transient simulation tools such as Dymola or MATLAB Simulink

You'll join a well-established and supportive team that will help you settle in, develop your expertise and build confidence. As your experience grows, you'll be given the autonomy and responsibility to take ownership of your work, while always having access to support and guidance when needed. It's an opportunity to help safeguard one of Ireland's most valuable natural resources, protect our proud heritage of high-quality drinking water and make a lasting contribution to communities across Ireland. **About You** You're a motivated engineer who enjoys solving complex challenges and wants to make a meaningful contribution to Ireland's drinking water future. You enjoy working with others, bringing energy to projects and helping clients, communities and colleagues achieve the best possible outcomes. Whether working with ecologists, environmental scientists, operators, planners, regulators or fellow engineers, you'll appreciate that technical excellence is only part of the answer. You're also a strong communicator, able to explain complex technical concepts clearly and adapt your approach for different audiences, from technical specialists through to clients and non-technical stakeholders. **Key Attributes And Experience Include** * Bachelor's degree in Civil, Environmental, Chemical or Process Engineering, or a related discipline. * Chartered Engineer status or working towards chartership. * Experience in drinking water treatment, water infrastructure or related water sector projects. * Knowledge of drinking water treatment technologies, water quality objectives and industry best practice. * Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills. * Experience working within multidisciplinary teams and engaging with a range of stakeholders. * A passion for sustainable water solutions and protecting Ireland's water resources. **WHY JOIN US** * We put people first: We're proud of our friendly, inclusive and collaborative environment where everyone feels valued and driven to succeed. * We are driven to achieve: Named in the top 50 companies to work by Glassdoor 2025. Recognised by Corporate Knights as one of the world's top 10 most sustainable companies 2025. = * We do what is right: Industry leading training and development as well as paid for professional subscriptions. A professional progression plan, supporting you to become chartered. * We are better together: A supportive and collaborative team environment to assist with the growth of your career. * Growth: We're on an exciting growth journey across the Ireland - we want you to be part of it! * Great Benefits: Competitive salary, enhanced pension plan, annual leave with the option to buy/sell additional days, private medical insurance, group income protection & life assurance included as standard! **About Stantec** Whether you’re starting out on your engineering career or are looking for a fresh challenge, Ryan Hanley, now part of Stantec, is a great career move. You’ll be working for a dynamic company with an excellent reputation in the industry. Ryan Hanley, now part of Stantec, offers a great working environment amongst friendly professionals with an emphasis on teamwork. It’s a company where your ideas and opinions will be valued and your efforts recognised and rewarded. title: Weekend Receptionist - Elm Green Nursing Home
description: Be the welcoming face of Elm Green Nursing Home! At Elm Green Nursing Home, we believe that exceptional care starts with a warm welcome. If you enjoy working with people, have excellent administrative skills and take pride in delivering outstanding customer service, we would love to hear from you! Key Responsibilities Reception & Administration * Welcome residents, relatives, visitors and colleagues in a friendly, courteous and professional manner. * Answer incoming telephone calls promptly, direct enquiries appropriately and ensure accurate messages are passed on without delay. * Manage incoming and outgoing correspondence, daily post, emails and general administrative tasks. * Maintain an organised, clean and presentable reception area. * Maintain accurate documentation, filing systems and administrative records in line with company procedures and applicable HIQA standards. * Assist with diary management, appointments, printing, scanning, faxing and document distribution. * Monitor office supplies and equipment, reporting shortages or faults to the appropriate manager. * Arrange transport for residents and staff, as required. * Support the administration of tele-monitoring systems and relevant office procedures. * Follow up on missed clock-ins and attendance queries, escalating relevant information to management. * Assist with approved administrative requests relating to resident billing, telephone calls, sundry items and withdrawals, in accordance with established procedures. * Prepare and distribute nursing home brochures and information for prospective residents and their families. * Assist with viewings of bedrooms and communal areas for prospective residents and visitors. * Undertake other reasonable administrative duties as directed by management. Confidentiality & Professional Standards * Maintain strict confidentiality regarding residents, families, colleagues and nursing home records. * Handle personal and sensitive information in accordance with company policies and applicable data protection legislation. * Attend mandatory training, in-service training and staff meetings as required. * Demonstrate a respectful, professional and person-centred approach in all interactions. * Represent Elm Green Nursing Home positively when dealing with external contacts and members of the public. **Skills & Experience** The ideal candidate will demonstrate: * Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. * A warm, approachable and professional manner. * A confident and courteous telephone manner. * Strong organisational, administrative and time-management skills. * Good typing skills and attention to detail. * Proficiency in Microsoft Word and Outlook. * The ability to multitask, prioritise and work effectively in a busy environment. * Reliability, punctuality and a strong sense of responsibility. * The ability to handle confidential information with discretion. * Flexibility to work weekends, Bank Holidays and additional cover when required. * A positive, proactive attitude and the ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team. * A genuine commitment to providing an excellent experience for residents, families and visitors. * Previous reception or administrative experience, particularly in a healthcare or care setting, would be an advantage. title: Trainee Designer – Placement Student
description: **Trainee Designer — Student Placement Year** **Because you’ll make the difference** Ready to own your career in an ever-growing fashion hub? Then take on a Primark placement starting in Summer 2027. This is your chance to grab valuable experience in a global company that truly feels like a family. You’ll have real projects with real autonomy. You’ll get to know incredible experts who make our fashion a reality. And you’ll gain off-the-scale exposure, making a huge impact for our customers and your future. Want it? Then own it on our undergraduate placement programme. **Because you matter** People are at the heart of what we do, so it’s essential that we provide you with the right environment to perform at your very best. We offer benefits that put you first: * Pay rate: Generous EUR 30,000 salary * Development: A 12 month development programme which kicks off with our Freshers Week * Balance: Our ‘Your Day, Your Way’ approach means you can finish up at 2pm every Friday if you’ve done your 37.5 hours that week * Discounts: Use your in-store colleague discount across our fabulous range * Support: Explore our well-being initiatives and Employee Assistance Programme, Let’s Talk. As well as mentorship to get the most out of your year * Holiday: Enjoy 27 days holiday on top of the Bank Holidays And if you need to relocate to Dublin for the role: * We’ll support you with opening a bank account and registering for tax and social security in Ireland. * Not sure where to live? Primark will help with finding accommodation for the year. **About You** If you’re an undergraduate looking for a 12 month placement before you head back to university for your final year, we’d love to hear from you. If you’re in your last year at university or have already graduated, head back to the careers website to find other roles across the business. **What You’ll Need** Whether your degree is in Fashion Design, Graphic Design or Textile Design – you'll show us a creative portfolio that we wish was ours. You’ll want to drive newness every single time, and you’ll thrive from meeting deadlines and shifting priorities. Of course, you’ll be happy to handle your own projects with the support of others, whether you’re hand-drawing or working directly on the Mac. If you’re a creative multitasker who can put their ideas across to others, and you have working knowledge of Adobe Creative Cloud, Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign, the Primark placement in Design is the perfect fit for you. **What You’ll Do** You’ll help research and design a commercial range, from considering new techniques and fabrics, to finding out about, and then adapting the latest trends into Primark handwriting. It’s your chance to create typographically strong graphics and prints alongside our Design team and develop garment shape design. You’ll gain an understanding of our products over time, but there will be detail too — you’ll follow briefs carefully, track amends and prepare design files for meetings with suppliers and more. **Why should you apply?** In Primark, we’ve always said everyone’s invited and we’re committed to making everyone feel safe and comfortable to be themselves. We believe that a diverse, inclusive, and accessible environment elevates us all, and enables creative ideas and collaboration to flourish. Because when we work together, we can accomplish so much more. And yes, this place moves fast, and it’s growing even faster but we’re committed to providing the best, and most socially and environmentally ethical fashion that’s affordable for everyone. Primark Cares is our commitment to reducing fashion waste, halving our carbon footprint, and improving the lives of the people who make our products. This placement has real impact, you could even see the results of your work, out on the shop floor! Make your CV look amazing and if you wow us, there could be a permanent job up for grabs when you graduate. **Isn’t it time you put theory into practice? We think so. Apply now for a Primark placement and start owning your journey.** **About The Placement** You don’t watch from the sidelines around here — you get stuck in. Through hands-on experience and responsibility from the get-go, you’ll gain a vast insight into how our business works and contribute to it from day one. Inspiring, supportive colleagues will make you feel welcome and valued. And we’ll also help you to develop your skill set and grow your potential through supported learning with on-the-job training, masterclasses, and an assigned buddy. **Before applying, please ensure that i** **f you are offered a place on the programme, it has been approved by your university or educational institution.** **Closing date: Friday, 6th November 2026. We reserve the right to close the application window early should we receive sufficient applications** **REQ ID:** JR-14777
